# Arshaq Hisham — Product × Engineering Portfolio

> Arshaq Hisham is a product and engineering professional based in Saskatoon, SK, Canada, with a decade of experience building systems where software meets high-stakes domains: ERP and process re-engineering consulting at KPMG (2016–2018), four years owning business analysis for the COSMIC electronic health record at Cambio Software Engineering (2019–2022, HL7/FHIR/openEHR/SNOMED CT/GDPR), and Product Owner of a multi-tenant B2B e-commerce search platform for Wurth industrial suppliers at Villvay Systems (Dec 2022–present). His work pairs product judgment with real engineering depth: roadmaps and ROI reviews alongside Elasticsearch DSL, tRPC and Airflow DAGs. Recent focus: hands-on LLM agent engineering — a multi-agent AI App Generator (Mastra + E2B sandboxes + Vercel AI SDK v5) and a production solo-built travel booking platform, ELUX Travels (eluxtravels.uk, ~46k lines of TypeScript, live).

This site is his public portfolio, intended for recruiters, hiring managers and future colleagues who want to understand who he is, what he has shipped, and where he fits in a workplace. All metrics shown on the site are verified from the actual codebases. A private job-search knowledge base (target companies, applications, resume recipes) is intentionally excluded from this public site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://arshaq.webcules.com/): portfolio overview — intro, "where I fit in a workplace", career timeline, detailed experience (KPMG, Cambio, Villvay), flagship projects, skills and industry domains, contact.
- [Knowledge graph](https://arshaq.webcules.com/graph): interactive force-directed graph of 37 linked notes (roles, projects, skills, domains, technologies). Click any node to read it; supports search and category filters; notes are deep-linkable via URL hash.
- [Graph data (JSON)](https://arshaq.webcules.com/graph-data.json): machine-readable graph — `{generated, notes: [{id, title, folder, color, text}], links: [[noteIndexA, noteIndexB], ...]}`. The note texts are the same public-safe knowledge-base notes the graph renders.
- [Full text version](https://arshaq.webcules.com/llms-full.txt): the complete portfolio content as plain markdown, for LLM ingestion without rendering HTML.
